caption:
🚂 Hungary's railways, built at their real dates — 1846 → today.

Look at the shape: a star, with almost every line pointing to Budapest 🗺️ Nearly all of it was laid before 1918, for a kingdom about three times larger than today's Hungary. When the borders were redrawn in 1920, many of those lines were simply cut at the new frontier.

📊 Data: OpenHistoricalMap (opening and closure dates) + OpenStreetMap (gaps), ODbL. Coverage is uneven, some lines are missing or undated.
🌍 Land: Natural Earth
